changes.title: Menu Back restores the existing title
changes.text: Android keeps one inactive title while known menus are open. Back restores its existing controls, graphics, cameras and pointer order without recreating the screen. Hidden controls cannot receive input; held presses are cancelled. Resume, reset, context/display changes, callbacks and gameplay discard the retained title. APD Settings and title layout remain unchanged.

changes.title: Ready UIMSD content is drawn without an extra frame
changes.text: UIMSD builds ready content before drawing as well as during update, retaining modal protection. Pending menu requests are applied before draw so an outgoing screen is not drawn again after navigation has already chosen its destination. History integrity and asynchronous loading remain intact.

changes.title: Real lifecycle and native tap performance are checked
changes.text: Ten engine cases check retained title identity, cameras, isolated pointers and Back, one-parent lifetime, held press cancellation, invalidation, callbacks and destruction. Nine native Back routes require the original title and camera. A real Android tap must draw the complete Home from a separately marked72-run fixture within250ms, respecting ordinary Home filtering.
